description_zh: 调用DisableSqlConcurrencyControl接口，关闭指定限流规则
kebab_example: aliyun das disable-sql-concurrency-control --console-context None --instance-id rm-2ze1jdv45i7l60000 --item-id 1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DisableSqlConcurrencyControl

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID.

The database instance must be an ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL instance or a PolarDB for MySQL cluster
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。
仅支持RDS MySQL和PolarDB MySQL版实例
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the throttling rule that is applied to the instance. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/223538.html operation to query the ID
parameters.help_zh: 当前实例限流规则ID，可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/223538.html接口获取
parameters.name: item_id
